Upgrade / supersede: creates a NEW row + JWT (same customer and fingerprint binding), marks the
previous row superseded (`superseded_by_license_id`) without revocation. Supply exactly one of
`licenseKey` (full REGK) or `issuedLicenseId` (row id when `GET list` returns masked keys).
Rejects when the stored expiry is after the requested new expiry, or when the row is revoked/already superseded.

Creates a NEW issued row + JWT (same expiry, same customer); old row gets `transferred_to_license_id` (audit; not revoked).
Caller must supply the new server's SHA-256 machine fingerprint (`newMachineHashHex`), typically from `/api/health/license`.

Renew an issued license: creates a new row (new `licenseKey` + JWT), revokes the previous row for audit.
Body: `newExpiryDate` (YYYY-MM-DD, end-of-day UTC) must be in the future. Supply exactly one of
`licenseKey` (full REGK) or `issuedLicenseId` (row id from GET list).

AuditLog.description:
Audit log entity – immutable event stream. Compliance invariants:
1. Append-only: records are only inserted; updates to existing rows are rejected (see AppDbContext.SaveChanges).
2. No audit record may be modified after write; deletion only via dedicated retention (DeleteAuditLogsOlderThanAsync).
3. Every event must contain actor (UserId), timestamp (Timestamp), and actionType (Action/ActionType).
4. Sensitive data must never be logged (password, tokens, credentials, taxNumber, security stamps); use UserAuditDiffHelper whitelist.
5. Consumers (e.g. UI) must gracefully handle incomplete historical records (null/legacy fields).
